verdict.rationale: Cline's Kanban board explicitly supports running multiple coding agents in parallel with isolated git worktrees, auto-commit, and dependency chains (cline-docs-5, cline-docs-24, cline-gh-2), which enables parallel task attempts on isolated branches. However, there is no documented feature for explicitly comparing multiple attempt outputs side-by-side or a 'pick the best result' UI — the evidence only shows isolation via worktrees, leaving comparison/selection to manual git review. Missing for 10: explicit multi-attempt comparison UI, documented workflow for selecting/discarding parallel attempts, independent/hands-on confirmation of this exact use case.
